_comment: Invrisil 8c Task C3 (issue #13) 'A Gentleman's Disagreement' -- STEALTH/SKILL path -> the EXPOSE fork. Loads near_invrisil_stealth (took_brothers_job already banked, standing beside the new counting_house_ledger prop) via title Continue. Full loop: lift the true ledger ([Appraise Foe], banks lifted_true_ledger) -> teleport to Master Coyle on the boulevard, accuse him with the ledger evidence (accusation -> cornered), choose EXPOSE (banks merchant_exposed + merchant_fate_decided -> quest beat 1) -> teleport to Wilovan at the parlor, report (banks brothers_job_done + cleared_brothers_name + the shared brothers_marker -> quest beat 2 + quest_completed) and prove the SAFE-PASSAGE reward fires (entity_removed on BOTH alley footpads, either fork's shared 'quest complete' moment). Teleport is used between the 3 maps deliberately -- the door-chain navigation across boulevard/alleys/parlor is already proven by invrisil_walkthrough; this canonical isolates the quest/fork logic instead of re-deriving that route a third time.
